subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage architecture as the supported path toward authoritative local token accounting while retaining legacy as the default rollback?
rationale: The implementation is guarded and well proven, but it introduces a large second accounting model and promotion contract whose long-term product and maintenance direction cannot be determined from tests alone.

options.title: Sponsor the guarded stack
options.body: Review and merge all four PRs in order, retaining legacy authority until separate promotion evidence is approved.

options.title: Narrow to shadow diagnostics
options.body: Accept measurement and diagnostic seams but remove or defer the lineage authority-selection path.

options.title: Pause the architecture
options.body: Keep current targeted containment fixes and defer the full lineage model until a smaller design is proposed.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the guarded stack
recommendation.body: Review and merge all four PRs in order, retaining legacy authority until separate promotion evidence is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository and Codex cost-scanner feature owner is the best available authority for this architectural product choice.
